data.one_liner: Annotations for Monarch to define themes and locales for isolated widget development.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations used by Monarch to help developers annotate their application themes and locales. It allows configuring how themes and internationalization are handled within the Monarch isolated widget environment.
use_when: You are using Monarch to build and test Flutter widgets in isolation.
You need to annotate custom themes and locales for Monarch.
avoid_when: You are not using the Monarch tool for widget development.
You need a general-purpose state management or UI library.
strengths: Enables seamless theme and localization integration with Monarch.
weaknesses: Provides no functionality outside of Monarch usage.
Requires the Monarch toolset to be of any use.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to your pubspec.yaml and use the annotations in your code as documented by Monarch.

alternatives.name: widgetbook
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you use Widgetbook instead of Monarch for building and testing Flutter widgets in isolation.
